lead: Bags, wallets, eyewear, umbrellas and other carried accessories, organised by what the thing is (handbag, wallet, frame, suitcase…), then by named icon and version for the collected kinds.

depts.note: Model → version (e.g. Kelly Sellier / Retourné) → size → leather → hardware → year stamp, as resale platforms list them.

b.v: hand-sewn (saddle stitch) > machine-sewn
b.w: Hand labour leads at the top end (Hermès quotes many hours per bag).

b.v: exotic and full-grain > top-grain > corrected/coated
b.w: Leather grade follows craftsmanship.
Icon models hold their value; resale platforms organise by them.

b.v: date code / year stamp, receipt, dust bag, box
b.w: Resale and authentication services grade by these.
Weighed last; set by scarcity and demand.

s.brief: Archetypes in significance order: Hermès Birkin, Kelly (versions Sellier, Retourné, Kelly II; sizes; leathers; hardware; year stamp as detail), Lady Dior, LV Speedy and Alma, Prada Galleria, Gucci Horsebit 1955 top-handle/Bamboo 1947, Loewe Puzzle, Jacquemus Le Bambino. Fold the old Kelly Messenger range note into the Kelly archetype. Doctor/bowling/barrel models become their own kinds.

k.brief: Remove generic 'Barrel bag', 'Bowling bag', 'Doctor's bag' model rows (they become kinds); Hermès range 'Kelly' once only.
Hinged-frame bag opening wide at the top (Gladstone); archetypes e.g. Gladstone bag, Mulberry/other named icons if sourced.
Domed, zip-top bag with two handles; LV Alma, Prada Bowling, Speedy-like Boston bags (Speedy may sit here or under top-handle; pick one).
Cylindrical top-handle bag; Fendi/LV examples if sourced.

s.brief: Tote archetypes: LV Neverfull, Goyard Saint Louis, Longchamp Le Pliage, Dior Book Tote, Hermès Garden Party, The Row Park, Bottega Veneta Andiamo/Cabat. Canvas tote is a QoL kind (L.L.Bean Boat and Tote as icon). Bucket: LV Noé, Mansur Gavriel bucket; kinchaku and reticule as maker-free archetypes. Satchel: Cambridge Satchel Company, Mulberry Bayswater, Valentino Rockstud. Tumi Alpha/Alpha Bravo/Harrison/Voyageur ranges belong in Tumi's brand entry, not here: drop them from the kind.

k.brief: Cotton canvas tote (boat tote, shopper); QoL, few archetypes.

s.brief: Shoulder: Chanel Classic Flap (11.12), 2.55 Reissue, Boy, Chanel 19; Gucci Jackie 1961; Prada Re-Edition 2005/2000; Celine Triomphe; Bottega Veneta Cassette; Chloé Paddington; Fendi Peekaboo; Mulberry Alexa/Lily; Givenchy Antigona; Coach Tabby; Alaïa Le Teckel. Hobo: Bottega Veneta Jodie, Chloé Marcie, Gucci Jackie (hobo origin) — place each icon once. Baguette: Fendi Baguette (versions/reissues). Saddle: Dior Saddle (Galliano 1999, 2018 reissue). Crossbody/messenger: Burberry, Khaite, Bottega Bang Bang. Half-moon bag stays a maker-free archetype under Shoulder bag.

k.brief: Hermès Kelly range row is redundant (Kelly is an archetype under Top-handle bag); add Chrome Industries Citizen, Timbuk2 Classic, Manhattan Portage as unisex messenger icons.

s.brief: Pochette: LV Pochette Accessoires, Pochette Métis; Clutch: Jimmy Choo, Bottega Veneta Pouch, Toteme T-Lock; Minaudière: Judith Leiber crystal minaudières, Van Cleef & Arpels (originator, 1930s). Wristlet bag keeps its definition vs wristlet wallet.

k.brief: Small flat bag with a short strap or chain, carried alone or clipped inside a larger bag.

b.v: full-grain (vegetable or chrome tanned) > top-grain > bonded
b.w: Leather grade decides how it ages.

b.v: hand saddle stitch, burnished or painted edges > machine stitch, raw edges
b.w: Edges and stitching wear first.
Card and note count against thickness; weighed after build.

s.brief: Broaden beyond Louis Vuitton: Bellroy (Note Sleeve, Hide & Seek), Ettinger, Smythson, Montblanc Meisterstück, Hermès (Béarn, Dogon), Bottega Veneta intrecciato, Goyard, Saint Laurent, Gucci, Tanner Goods, Shell Cordovan makers (Il Bussetto, Ashland), Chanel WOC (originator of wallet on chain), LV Zippy. One archetype per icon; no SKU colourways.

k.brief: Biker/trucker wallet; Japanese denim-scene makers (e.g. Red Moon) if sourced.

s.brief: Cardholders: Goyard Saint-Sulpice, Hermès Calvi, LV Pocket Organizer; minimalist: Ridge (metal), Bellroy, Secrid (aluminium card protector). Money clip: Tiffany, Ridge. Keyrings: trim the eight Tiffany SKUs to 2–3 archetypes; add Hermès, LV key holders. Passport cover: Smythson, LV, Bellroy.

depts.note: ONE department for all frames: sunglasses, optical frames and readers. Kinds are frame shapes; lens type (sun, polarised, prescription, photochromic, plano) is a type, not a kind.

b.v: UV400 / 100% UVA-UVB; glass or quality polycarbonate; polarisation optional
b.w: Standards ISO 12312-1 and ANSI Z80.3 for sunglasses.

b.v: block-cut acetate, titanium, beta-titanium > injected plastic; riveted multi-barrel hinges > single
b.w: Enthusiast and maker criteria (e.g. Persol, Moscot, JMM).

b.v: lens width · bridge · temple length
b.w: Printed on every frame; decides comfort before style.

b.v: originator > licensed reissue > interpretation
b.w: Collectors value originating models and period-correct details.

s.brief: Archetype standard: originator first. Aviator: Ray-Ban Aviator (Bausch & Lomb 1937), American Optical Original Pilot, Randolph Engineering Aviator, Persol 649 (pilot-shaped acetate). Trapezoid: Ray-Ban Wayfarer (1952), Persol 714 folding (Steve McQueen). Round/panto: Moscot Lemtosh, Oliver Peoples Gregory Peck / O'Malley, Lennon-style windsor. Browline: Shuron Ronsir (originator), Ray-Ban Clubmaster. Rimless: Cartier (Santos de Cartier, C Décor), Silhouette. Geometric/avant-garde: Jacques Marie Mage, Gentle Monster. Shield & wrap: Oakley (Frogskins, Eye Jacket, Radar), Oakley M Frame. Cut Ray-Ban SKU variants into versions of their archetype. Each kind gets t types for lens type (sun, polarised, prescription, photochromic, plano).

k.brief: Rename from 'Aviator sunglasses'; definition covers sun and optical.
Wayfarer-style; 'Wayfarer' is the archetype name, not the kind.
Hexagonal, octagonal and other angular lenses.
Cartier, Silhouette; drilled lenses or nylon-thread half-rims.
One-piece shield or wraparound sport sunglasses; Oakley as originator icons.
Frames that fold at bridge and temples; Persol 714, Ray-Ban Folding Wayfarer.

s.brief: Tier mode: brands covering most of the market (EssilorLuxottica house brands, Warby Parker, Specsavers, Zenni, Foster Grant readers) plus test winners; trim Warby Parker eight SKUs to 2–3. Prescription glasses absorb 'Prescription sunglasses' and 'Spectacle frame' (lens type and glazing as types: single vision, varifocal, bifocal, tinted, blue-light). Accessories are QoL kinds.

k.brief: t: single vision · varifocal · bifocal · prescription sunglasses · frame only for glazing.
Tinted lenses that clip or magnet onto a spectacle frame.
Retainer cord or chain holding glasses round the neck; Croakies as icon.

depts.note: Tier for everyday and school packs; variety at the one-bag enthusiast end.

b.v: type and weave first (CORDURA, X-PAC, Dyneema composite); 420D–1000D for travel packs
b.w: Fabric is weighed first; denier alone does not decide.
Double stitch lines, bar tacks, reinforced bottom and strap anchors.
Large YKK or other coil zippers (they fail first); buckles and strap anchors.
Weighed after materials and build.

b.v: lifetime > limited
b.w: A long warranty and a repair service signal a bag built to last.

s.brief: One-bag/EDC icons: Aer Travel Pack, Peak Design Travel Backpack / Everyday Backpack, Tom Bihn Synik / Aeronaut, GORUCK GR1, Mystery Ranch 3-Day Assault, Porter (Yoshida) Tanker, Osprey Farpoint, Fjällräven Kånken (daypack icon), Herschel, JanSport SuperBreak. Laptop backpacks: Tumi Alpha range once (in brand register), Incase. Hiking: Osprey, Gregory, Deuter, Hyperlite. School backpacks: trim the 17 rows (Scout, Step by Step, DerDieDas, Lässig…) to market-covering brands; randoseru as archetype (Japanese tradition, tag baby). No SKU colourway lists.

k.brief: Home of the one-bag icons.
Tag baby (child view).
Light sack with drawstring shoulder cords (gym sack).

s.brief: Belt bag icons: Patagonia, Lululemon Everywhere Belt Bag, LV Bumbag, Gucci, Bum bag origins; Sling: Peak Design Everyday Sling, Bellroy, Away. Trim retailer-harvested sling SKUs (Dick's list) to archetypes.

depts.note: Tier for everyday suitcases; variety for trunks and heritage luggage.

b.v: aluminium, polycarbonate, ballistic nylon > ABS
b.w: Decides weight and how it fails.

b.v: double spinner wheels; replaceable wheels and handle
b.w: Wheels, wheel housings, telescoping handle and corners fail first.

b.v: large YKK coil zips; TSA-accepted locks
b.w: Zips fail first on soft luggage.

b.v: lifetime > limited
b.w: A long warranty and a repair service signal luggage built to last.

s.brief: Suitcase archetypes: Rimowa Original (Topas, aluminium, 1937 grooved design), Rimowa Classic/Essential (polycarbonate), Samsonite Cosmolite, Tumi 19 Degree / Alpha, Globe-Trotter Centenary, Away The Carry-On, Briggs & Riley Baseline (warranty icon). Trim Samsonite's 11 SKUs to a few archetypes. Trunks: Louis Vuitton (Malle courrier, wardrobe trunk), Goyard, Moynat, Globe-Trotter, Pinel et Pinel; remove the Rimowa suitcase ranges from Travel trunk. Vanity case: LV Nice/Boîte, Globe-Trotter vanity, train case. Hat box: LV Boîte Chapeau.

k.brief: Small hard case for toiletries and cosmetics (train case).

s.brief: Weekender archetypes: LV Keepall (1930), Hermès Haut à Courroies, Filson Duffle, Mulberry Clipper; duffel: Patagonia Black Hole, The North Face Base Camp Duffel; carpet bag as maker-free archetype under duffel. Gym bag: Nike Brasilia, Adidas. Toiletry bag: Dopp kit (originator, Charles Doppelt). Garment bag, dry bag (Sea to Summit, Ortlieb) stay QoL.

k.brief: Holdall sized for two or three days, leather or canvas, with handles and shoulder strap.
Sports holdall, often with a shoe or wet compartment.
Wash bag or Dopp kit for toiletries.

s.brief: QoL, tier mode: few market-covering brands each. Luggage lock: TSA-accepted padlocks (Master Lock, Samsonite). Luggage strap. Keep packing cube, luggage tag, luggage scale; Tumi tag model is fine as one row.

b.v: full-grain, bridle or ballistic nylon > coated/bonded
b.w: Decides how the bag ages under daily use.
Handle anchors, locks, zips and stitching fail first.

s.brief: Briefcase archetypes: Hermès Sac à dépêches / Kelly Dépêches, Swaine Adeney Brigg attaché, Ettinger, Mulberry Heritage, Filson Original Briefcase, Tumi Alpha (ranges once, in brand register: drop the repeated Tumi range rows), Porter Tanker briefcase. Attaché: Rimowa Attaché, Zero Halliburton (aluminium icon). Pilot case: keep QoL with 1–3 rows. Document folio new.

k.brief: Slim zip or flap leather case for papers or a laptop, carried in the hand.

depts.note: Tier for everyday umbrellas; variety for heritage makers and craft traditions.

b.v: solid-stick or steel shaft, fibreglass ribs, 8–16 ribs
b.w: Ribs and runner fail first; wind-tested designs (Senz, Davek) last longer.

b.v: high-density polyester or silk; Teflon finish
b.w: Sheds water and dries fast.

b.v: whole-stick (solid) > fitted handle
b.w: London heritage makers' criterion.

s.brief: Heritage makers: Swaine Adeney Brigg, Fox Umbrellas, James Smith & Sons (1830), Pasotti, Francesco Maglia; modern: Senz (storm), Davek, Blunt, Knirps (folding originator), EuroSCHIRM, Totes. Bubble and inverted become types of Stick umbrella. Traditions for parasols: Japanese wagasa (Gifu), Chinese oil-paper umbrella, Burmese Pathein umbrella.

k.brief: t: crook handle · bubble (dome canopy) · inverted (reverse-closing) · whole-stick.

s.brief: Traditions register: Kyō-sensu (Kyoto folding fan), Edo uchiwa, Marugame uchiwa (Japanese traditional crafts), Spanish abanico (Valencia), Chinese tuanshan/Hangzhou fans; brisé and cockade fans as archetypes. Existing named forms become archetypes; keep ceremonial-only forms (flabellum, rhipis) only if sensibly owned, else note for F4.

Bag charm archetypes: Fendi Bag Bugs, Hermès Rodeo, LV charms, Labubu-style plush charms if sourced. Twilly: Hermès Twilly (originator). Bag strap: guitar-strap style (Valentino Guitar Strap, Coach). Bag organiser and base shaper are QoL.

k.brief: Narrow silk scarf tied round a bag handle.

s.brief: Restraint only. Fashion cane: remove the 'Sword cane' model row (it moves to E4 Weapons; note it in the moves file as a kind there if the worker wants); keep Fashionable Canes ranges or trim. Shopping trolley: keep Reisenthel rows.

k.brief: Sword cane → E4 (hand over in moves file as a kind 'Sword cane').

depts.note: Shown in the Baby & child view.

b.v: ASTM F2236 (soft carriers) / EN 13209-2
b.w: Compliance is the entry bar.

b.v: M-position, IHDI 'hip-healthy' acknowledgement
b.w: International Hip Dysplasia Institute guidance.
Weighed after safety; newborn-to-toddler range.

s.brief: Tier: market-covering brands (Ergobaby, BabyBjörn, Tula, Boba, Didymos, Moby, Solly, Sakura Bloom ring slings) plus test winners. Framed child carrier backpack is new (Deuter Kid Comfort, Osprey Poco, Thule Sapling). All kinds tag baby.

k.brief: Framed hiking pack with a child seat; tag baby.

s.brief: Tier: Skip Hop, Babymel, Storksak, Fawn Design, Lässig; tag baby.

k.brief: Bag with changing mat and pockets for nappies and bottles (diaper bag).
